name: BRAKE GAP — can the momentum be removed on arrival?
blurb: Identical 0.72 m/s departures, 25.2 N s of momentum to shed. PragyaSpace positions the lead hand early, catches the rail at 4.8 s and lets the elbow and shoulder absorb the arrest over a quarter second. WorldVLA reaches late, misses the capture and takes the impulse from the bulkhead instead.
